title: Instructor, Accounting and Finance
bio: "In my first Financial Accounting Principles class in 2018, I had a theoretical physicist with a PhD, a priest, a biochemist with a PhD, several entrepreneurs, a couple of retirees, and numerous Harvard staff members working on advanced degrees." Field: Finance
